scope: Independent static review of archived native APK methods and runtime source. Loader apply tests and host behavior are separate reports; no device or ART trace is claimed.

checks.evidence: Constructor assigns p2/p3 to b/c and p4 boolean to d. b reads these same fields and invokes factory.d:wb0/t0.P. Fullwidth exclamation is not a bracket, so a2 punctuation normalization does not change it.

reviewed_decisions: Keep period type4 native tap/slider graph; bypass only its q popup construction for tagged exact singleton question.
Keep long-vowel type0 native tap and case restrictions; bypass only c language-variant merge using native H singleton construction.
Only marker plus matching primary/effective primary and one fullwidth alternate activates hooks. Native hidden secondary labels are accepted; other nonnull hints are rejected.
Binary edit occurs after preserved KeySwap logic and changes only extra tag, candidate list and optional hint UTF payloads. No geometry, native type, key position or unrelated key byte is edited.
FlickSymbols source is byte-identical; existing native popup and direct-release actor routes handle the two keys with unchanged angle, distance, acquisition deadline and canceled-stream ownership.
limitations: Native resource fixtures and smali methods are real; host builders/actors are explicit models, not executions of the Android application.
No device screenshot, actual touch sample, rendering or fluency-engine output is claimed.
Normal tap routing and popup candidate selection are justified by native static construction; host tests do not simulate the full Android longpress timer/window dispatch.
